in_subset_via: 基于分部求和法的和的估计

callouts.title: 定理1.1:Wintner mean value theorem,20世纪初
callouts.body: 如果算术函数$f$是另外一个算术函数$g$的Dirichlet卷积意义下的和，即$$f=1*g$$并且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$绝对收敛，那么$f$的平均值$M(f)$就是该级数收敛到的值,即：$$M(f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$$

classification_result.english_title: Theorem 1.1: Wintner Mean Value Theorem, Early 20th Century

if_problem.statement_en: If an arithmetic function $f$ is the Dirichlet convolution of $1$ with another arithmetic function $g$, that is, $$f=1*g,$$ and if the series $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$$ converges absolutely, then the mean value $M(f)$ of $f$ exists and equals the sum of that series, namely $$M(f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}.$$
key_techniques: mean value estimation of arithmetic functions

callouts.title: 想法1.2
callouts.body: 我们无非就是要估计和$S(x):=\frac{1}{x}\sum_{n\leq x}f(n)$精度要求至少是$o(1)$。因为$f=1*g$因此我们可以利用[[把条件函数展开为新的和或积分然后换序#1.1 卷积法的基本形式]]的"Dirichlet卷积法特殊形式1"，这样的话主项当中是关于$\sum_{n\leq x} \frac{g(n)}{n}$的，余项中主要是$\sum_{n\leq x}g(n)$。而我们知道$\frac{g(n)}{n}$的级数的收敛性，那么可以用[[Kronecker's lemma]]来得到余项的估计。

if_strategy_template.summary_en: To estimate the mean value sum $S(x):=\frac{1}{x}\sum_{n\le x} f(n)$ up to an $o(1)$ error, expand $f=1*g$ using the Dirichlet convolution method. This separates the main term involving $\sum_{n\le x} g(n)/n$ from an error term involving $\sum_{n\le x} g(n)$, which can then be controlled by Kronecker's lemma.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when an arithmetic function is given as a Dirichlet convolution with $1$, and one knows convergence information about $\sum g(n)/n$ and needs to prove existence of a mean value.

callouts.title: 引理1.3:Kronecker's lemma
callouts.body: 对于算术函数$f$，如果存在一个$s,\text{Re}(s)>0$使得$$\sum_{n\ge 1} \frac{f(n)}{n^s}<\infty$$那么$$\frac{1}{x^s}\sum_{n\leq x} f(n)\to 0$$

if_problem.statement_en: For an arithmetic function $f$, if there exists $s$ with $\operatorname{Re}(s)>0$ such that $$\sum_{n\ge 1} \frac{f(n)}{n^s}<\infty,$$ then $$\frac{1}{x^s}\sum_{n\le x} f(n)\to 0.$$

callouts.title: 命题1.4:从Dirichlet生成函数理解
callouts.body: 因为如果$f=g*1$，那么这个关系体现在Dirichlet生成函数上就是$$L(f,s):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{f(n)}{n^s}=\zeta(s)\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n^s},\text{Re}(s)>1$$然后$g$满足级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$绝对收敛那么$M(f)$存在且等于$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$

classification_result.english_title: Proposition 1.4: Understanding from the Dirichlet Generating Function

if_problem.statement_en: If $f=g*1$, then on the level of Dirichlet generating functions one has $$L(f,s):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{f(n)}{n^s}=\zeta(s)\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n^s},\quad \operatorname{Re}(s)>1.$$ If moreover the series $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$$ converges absolutely, then the mean value $M(f)$ exists and equals $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}.$$
key_techniques: mean value theorem for arithmetic functions

callouts.title: 定理2.1.1:Axer 1910
callouts.body:
如果算术函数$f$是另外一个算术函数$g$的Dirichlet卷积意义下的和，即$$f=1*g$$如果：
1. $\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$条件收敛
2. $\sum_{n\leq x}|g(n)|=O(x)$

那么$f$的平均值$M(f)$就是该级数收敛到的值,即：$$M(f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$$

if_problem.statement_en:
If an arithmetic function $f$ is the Dirichlet convolution of $1$ with another arithmetic function $g$, that is, $$f=1*g,$$ and if:
1. $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$$ converges conditionally,
2. $$\sum_{n\leq x}|g(n)|=O(x),$$
then the mean value $M(f)$ of $f$ exists and equals the sum of that series, namely $$M(f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}.$$

callouts.title: 引理2.1.2
callouts.body: 复数列$a_n$构成的级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{a_n}{n}$收敛，那么其部分和$\sum_{n\leq N}a_n =o(N)$。

if_problem.statement_en: If the series $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{a_n}{n}$$ formed from a complex sequence $a_n$ converges, then its partial sums satisfy $$\sum_{n\leq N} a_n=o(N).$$

callouts.title: 例子3.1
callouts.body: 定义算术函数$$P_{\alpha}(n)=\sum_{d|n} \sin(2\pi d\alpha)$$其中$\alpha\not \in \mathbb{Z}$。求极限$$\lim_{N\to \infty} \frac{1}{N}\sum_{n\leq N} P_{\alpha}(n)$$

if_problem.statement_en: Define the arithmetic function $$P_{\alpha}(n)=\sum_{d|n} \sin(2\pi d\alpha),$$ where $\alpha\not\in \mathbb{Z}$. Find the limit $$\lim_{N\to \infty} \frac{1}{N}\sum_{n\leq N} P_{\alpha}(n).$$
key_techniques: mean value theorem for arithmetic functions
